name: HIP Housing Home Sharing Program
description: Free matching service connecting people who have a room or ADU to rent with people seeking affordable shared housing
fullDescription: HIP Housing's Home Sharing Program is a free matching service that connects people who have a spare room or Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) with people seeking affordable housing in San Mateo County.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free housing matching service
- Interviews, screening, and background searches
- Matches for renting a room or an ADU
- Reduced-rent matches in exchange for help around the home
- Help setting up a Living Together Agreement
- Referrals to community resources
howToGetIt:
1. Fill out the Inquiry Form on the HIP Housing website or call 650-348-6660
2. Home Seekers must live, work, or attend school in San Mateo County; Home Providers must live in San Mateo County
3. Complete an interview and screening
4. Receive compatible matches and meet potential housemates
5. Finalize a Living Together Agreement
keywords: HIP Housing, home sharing, roommate matching, shared housing, San Mateo, affordable housing, housemate
